summary: Postinstall fetches CLI binary from a GitHub org unrelated to the declared publisher
details: install.cjs runs at postinstall and downloads a platform-specific executable from github.com/Apex-Foundation/copilot releases (pinned to a constant v1.0.0 that does not track the package version 1.0.11), writes it to the package's bin path, and chmods 0o755. The shipped bin/apex is a 0-byte placeholder, so the downloaded bytes are the entire CLI. No hash or signature verification is performed. The package's manifest declares author `Can Boluk` with repository `github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi`, and the README describes `@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent`, so the download source (`Apex-Foundation/copilot`) does not match either the manifest publisher or the README identity. The downloaded binary is opaque and its contents were not inspected.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
